conditional_scope: Fixed report probabilities and conditional independence. Flags occur strictly outside discrete count limits. Expected exceedances sum actual tail probabilities. These are not simultaneous national confidence intervals.
width_scope: Estimate the mean squared standardized residual from all airports, E at least five, or at least 100 reports; bound the factor below by one. Apply each factor to all national airports. Widen each side about E by its square root, preserving count bounds. Nominal coverage is unestablished.
display_scope: For hierarchical EBL, main E-at-least-five display has 144 airports and six flags. All 1,231 lower-E airports remain in the analysis, including all 602 zero-damage airports. No pseudocount is added for the zero-damage strip.
target_scope: Eight targets use separate frozen temporal predictions. Width sensitivity transfers the national hierarchical EBL factor of 1.675509. Conditional target ranges differ from joint development-and-year intervals.
units: Ranges are damage counts. Figure 2B divides count ranges by the corresponding E for display. Factors are dimensionless.
